title: Request a Room Change
wrap_friend: 你剛剛完成了一段 A2 住宿服務情境，說明需求、聽懂回覆，並確認下一步。
learner_goal: Ask for a room change with a simple reason and confirm the move timing.
register_notes: Broad everyday English hotel-service register; polite, short A2 responses; no complaint escalation.
support_text: Give one simple reason and ask whether you can change rooms.

friend.hint: Ask for a room change with one reason.

choices.surface: My room is a little noisy. Can I change rooms?
choices.translation: 我的房間有點吵。可以換房嗎？
choices.speak: My room is a little noisy. Can I change rooms?

choices.surface: Can I change my restaurant table?
choices.speak: Can I change my restaurant table?
choices.feedback: This is about a hotel room, not a restaurant table.

choices.surface: I will make an official report.
choices.speak: I will make an official report.
choices.feedback: Formal reporting is outside this A2 task.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: I checked. We have one other room.
turns.speak: I checked. We have one other room.

inline_explain.title: A2 pattern
inline_explain.explain: A useful pattern for this accommodation situation.

choices.surface: There is one other room, right?
choices.speak: There is one other room, right?

choices.surface: There is one other ticket, right?
choices.speak: There is one other ticket, right?
choices.feedback: This is a room, not a ticket.
Compensation is outside this simple room-change task.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: You can move to the new room in thirty minutes.
turns.speak: You can move to the new room in thirty minutes.
turns.translation: 三十分鐘後可以搬到新房間。

choices.surface: I can move in thirty minutes, right?
choices.translation: 三十分鐘後可以搬，對嗎？
choices.speak: I can move in thirty minutes, right?

choices.surface: I check out in three hours, right?
choices.speak: I check out in three hours, right?
choices.feedback: The staff said you can move in thirty minutes.

choices.surface: I will move because I need a hospital.
choices.translation: 因為要去醫院，所以要換。
choices.speak: I will move because I need a hospital.
choices.feedback: Medical reasons are outside this task.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: When it is ready, I will give you the new key card.
turns.speak: When it is ready, I will give you the new key card.
turns.translation: 準備好後，我會給您新房卡。

choices.surface: Okay. I will take the new key when it is ready.
choices.translation: 好，準備好後我拿新房卡。
choices.speak: Okay. I will take the new key when it is ready.

choices.surface: No, I will change my train time.
choices.speak: No, I will change my train time.
choices.feedback: This is room change, not transport.

choices.surface: I will tell the police now.
choices.speak: I will tell the police now.
choices.feedback: Police workflows are outside this task.

feedback: Distractors test wrong time, place, service domain, or out-of-scope escalation while preserving A2 boundaries.
tts_segments: I checked. We have one other room.
You can move to the new room in thirty minutes.
When it is ready, I will give you the new key card.
runtime_notes: EN A2 accommodation candidate. Full-walk runtime gate required before final closeout.

notes.authoring_policy: Fresh-authored from the neutral A2 accommodation brief. KO surfaces were not translated.
notes.a2_boundary: Low-risk accommodation/service task; avoids compensation, emergency, legal, medical, police, immigration, banking, insurance, or identity-sensitive handling.
